status: External observation only; not compatibility or quality evidence.

measurements.observation: A six-character user-only prompt reported prompt_tokens=2487; adding a short system message reduced the same call to 15-33 tokens.
measurements.impact: Without a system message the router injects a large instruction block, so reported usage does not equal the caller's prepared context.

measurements.observation: max_tokens in {1,4,8,32}, max_completion_tokens in {1,8}, both, and omitted all returned the same 182 completion tokens with finish_reason=stop.
measurements.impact: A declared output limit cannot be assumed to bound remote work or cost at this endpoint.

measurements.observation: A refused prompt returned HTTP 200 with finish_reason=failed, empty content and zeroed usage.
measurements.impact: Refusal must be classified by finish reason and must not be accepted as supported text.

measurements.observation: GET /v1/models returned 200 with no key and with an invalid key; chat required a valid key.
measurements.impact: A models probe cannot be used as an authorization check.

measurements.observation: /v1/chat/completions worked; /chat/completions returned an HTML 404; /v1/v1/chat/completions returned 400 JSON; a trailing slash returned 308; stream=true produced text/event-stream.
measurements.impact: Append chat/completions exactly once, reject non-JSON content types and disable redirects.

measurements.observation: Upstream 400/403/404/503 bodies contained provider names, internal connection identifiers and localized provider messages.
measurements.impact: Error classification must use status plus a local enum; provider bodies must never be returned as public diagnostics.

decision: Do not use 9router as a runtime dependency, CI fixture, or compatibility claim. The refusal finish reason, SSE/content-type and redirect observations are encoded as negative fixtures; the hidden-prompt and unauthenticated-models observations remain design notes only.
